Bean Point, the island's secret-that-isn.note: No Wikimedia Commons photo found under an allowed licence for Bean Point specifically; left as a gap rather than substituting an unrelated beach image. Pass 2 (2026-09-23): Searched Openverse for "Bean Point Anna Maria Island", "Bean Point Anna Maria" (source=flickr), "Bean Point beach", "Bean Point Florida" (source=flickr), "Anna Maria Island north end beach" (source=flickr) and "Bean Point sunset" (source=flickr). Found one CC BY-SA 2.0 Flickr photo titled "Bean Point, Anna Maria, Florida" (Ken Lund) but rejected it: it is a hazy shot through an airplane window at altitude, with no geotag, no description and no readable signage, so it cannot be verified as the ground-level sunset vantage this pick describes rather than just the island's general shape seen from a plane.
